name: stock.alerts/v1
description: Back-in-stock requests: the shop's product page hands a shopper's "tell me when it is back" for a sold-out item to the plugin that keeps the requests, confirms them and sends the news when the item can be bought again (STOCK_ALERTS.md).

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Whether requests are taken now, and the sentence the form shows beside the email box.
methods.agent_reason: a back-in-stock request is a shopper's, sent from the shop's product page; the owner reads and removes them through the stock-alerts plugin's own abilities

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Keep one shopper's request for one sold-out item, and confirm it to them; the same request again changes nothing.
methods.agent_reason: a back-in-stock request is a shopper's, sent from the shop's product page; the owner reads and removes them through the stock-alerts plugin's own abilities
